item.title: Patch now: Critical authentication bypass and command injection in Progress WS_FTP
item.description:
Progress WS_FTP: Authentication bypass · fix available · CCB: patch immediately

First step: Install the security update for Progress WS_FTP. The CCB advisory lists the affected and fixed versions.

The Centre for Cybersecurity Belgium (CCB) warns about this and advises to patch immediately. The CCB advisory lists the affected versions and the fix.

Critical · Fix available
